headline: Petition by Zayo to install fiber optic telecommunication facilities on Armory Street and Stafford Street.
summary: The meeting will consider one petition from Zayo. The petition covers installing and maintaining fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way near 409 Armory St.
items: Petition 1: Zayo - Armory Street, to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way, from an existing hand hole on Armory St across from Grover St. to Utility Pole#1469/E1 on Stafford St., at 409 Armory St in Springfield, MA
location: 426 Armory Street (Boland Elementary School parking lot)
